zh-CN.title: 投稿协作与管理优化
items: 审批者现在可以邀请其他审批者共同处理投稿
投稿详情移除了清除记录；首位投稿者可以永久删除投稿
投稿消息的长按菜单不再提供多选操作

en.title: Improved submission collaboration
items: Reviewers can now invite additional reviewers to collaborate
Removed history clearing; original authors can permanently delete submissions
Removed multi-select from submission message menus
